status: strategy definition frozen before new ETF signals or outcomes; broker costs separately frozen before accounts

source.membership: fixed current-member research sample; no substitutions or retrospective membership claim
source.price_convention: Existing Yahoo revised-vintage adjusted close for signals/mark ratios; provider-reported split reconstruction for nominal close and ATR; preserve every action record and missing session; no corporate-action cash-ledger qualification

signal.fit_indices: k=t-61 through t-2 inclusive, requiring 61 consecutive fitting prices t-62 through t-2
signal.availability: all 63 consecutive adjusted closes t-62..t for ETF and SPY finite positive; current reconstructed nominal close and ATR finite positive; strictly positive finite SPY centered sum of squares and residual scale
signal.roundoff_gate: unavailable when residual L2 norm <=64*float64 epsilon*max(ETF fitting-return L2 norm,fitted-return L2 norm,float64 tiny); no variance floor, zero filling or adjusted threshold
signal.trend_gate: SPY adjusted close[t] > arithmetic mean of 200 consecutive finite positive SPY adjusted closes t-199..t; unavailable trend history means no trend-arm signal
signal.interpretation: z is a fixed residual-dislocation score, not a calibrated p-value or forecast; sqrt(2) scaling ignores serial covariance and fitted-parameter uncertainty

arms.name: residual_reversal_trend
arms.rule: same reversal candidates and ranking, only when the declared SPY trend gate is known and true

arms.name: matched_count_control
arms.rule: on an unfiltered reversal alert date, K is its candidate count; take the first K shared-eligible ETFs sorted by SHA256(control_seed+ISO_signal_session+':'+symbol), then symbol, independently of z rank; otherwise no candidates

control_interpretation: date/candidate-count matched and return-blind; may overlap reversal candidates; realized position count, risk sizing and exposure can differ; no exposure-matched causal-performance claim

timing.decision: official XNYS signal-session close plus one minute; daily bars treated as available at that historical clock under the existing retrospective-data assumption
timing.exit: entry session index plus three, independently per position
timing.horizon_refinement: Original proposal suggested two; unchanged cash engine accepts 1/3/5. Three selected before signals/outcomes to test short correction without shared constant mutation or an additional exit engine. Two-session formation remains unchanged.

accounts.costs: Both existing broker profiles use one uniform round-trip ETF allowance: ceil(maximum duration-weighted mean quoted spread in basis points across all 33 predeclared cells))+10 basis points. Quote coverage must qualify before freezing its numerical value; no profitable-outcome selection.
accounts.cash_reference: two flat nominal-cash references, zero modeled interest/fees, not additional fitted policies
accounts.sizing: existing plan_entries whole shares, prior-close NAV/price/ATR, available settled cash plus scheduled settlements due by next opening; original fee-inclusive reservation retained; actual-fill quantity may only decrease
accounts.settlement: existing historical USD T+3/T+2/T+1 exchange/bank intersection; no spending sale proceeds before settlement
accounts.drawdown_halt: Starting peak is initial capital. Evaluate each close after due exits, fills and marks. At first drawdown >=30%, cancel newly pending entries without crediting cash (reservations were not debited), permanently disable new entries, and advance each held exit to min(original exit,next exchange-session close). Retain trigger NAV/peak, canceled intents and original/actual exits; preserve missing-price failure and any gap/friction overshoot.
accounts.continuous: one unreset account per arm/capital/broker across the full entry period; no deposits or calendar-year resets
accounts.missing_required_prices: invalidate account and preserve ledger prefix; never use future entry/exit availability to remove or rerank a current candidate
accounts.restrictions: cash-funded long ETFs only; no borrowing, ETF shorts, options, inverse/leveraged substitution or modification of reserved ETF portfolios/paper policy

reporting.calendar_weeks: retain full account weekly series including idle/loss weeks; report fractions >=5/10/15%, median/worst week, longest consecutive losing-week streak; initialization and liquidation-tail weeks labelled
reporting.refutation: cash reversal is unsupported if declared net account returns fail to exceed cash, if excess over the matched-count control is absent or unstable across years, or if the result depends on one ETF/short episode or violates the drawdown gate. Trend filtering is unsupported if its fee/risk-adjusted improvement is absent; lower losses with substantially lower exposure do not establish better alpha.
reporting.qualification: exploratory current-member revised-vintage study; existing historical prices have already supported other research and are not an untouched holdout; no proof of weekly target or deployable profitability
